provenanceNote: Approximates Adobe After Effects Echo (ADBE Echo) as a single-pass SkSL spatial trail: Cavalry's skslFilter has no temporal frame history, so the EchoTime offset is projected onto a fixed diagonal spatial smear (60/30 px per second) with geometric decay and multi-stage blending operators (Add, Screen, Maximum, Minimum, Composite). For authentic temporal echoing, use a layer-duplicate rig with time offsets.

parameters.description: Temporal offset between consecutive echo instances.
